Title: Public Preview: Multi-agent workflows in Foundry Agent Service

Body.Content:
Developers can now build robust multi-agent workflows using both a visual designer and code-first API. These workflows provide structured orchestration, context sharing, persistent state, and error recovery for complex enterprise processes. The modular design supports secure data handling, extensibility, and long-term state management, making it ideal for advanced automation and enterprise use cases.

Learn more.
